name: How long does it take to paint and finish a typical room addition?
description: Painting and finishing a room addition typically takes several days to over a week, depending on size, complexity, and finish types.

mainEntity.name: How long does it take to paint and finish a typical room addition?

acceptedAnswer.text: The timeline for painting and finishing a typical room addition varies depending on its size, complexity, and the type of finishes chosen. Generally, after construction is complete, the painting and finishing phase can take anywhere from a few days to over a week. Factors like extensive trim work, multiple colors, or specialized finishes can extend this duration. For example, if you opt for custom cabinetry or built-ins within the addition, the finishing of these elements can add extra time beyond just wall and ceiling painting. Coordinating with other trades, such as flooring installers, is also crucial to ensure a smooth, efficient process without delays.
acceptedAnswer.description: Painting and finishing a room addition typically takes several days to over a week, depending on size, complexity, and finish types.
